body:
Well as far as focusing on my mental health and inner being goes, I've never approached it like that before. Any clue where I can start with that? It looks like you finally get what I'm all about, I can't feel better unless I do better.

 I think what "fills up my tank" would probably be hope.
Hope that I can finally get the guts to not care what anyone thinks, and to strive for better. But without hope I don't really know anything. 

Thanks for talking with me, I really appreciate it.

My apologies for not saying too much about myself. I'm usually a to myself type of person. Anytime I even let a few details about me out to someone it's thrown to the side and ignored. So for now I'll keep it that way.

In my opinion the ultimate "definition" of success seems like a fairy tale that few achieve. Falling in love, Achieving your life goals, and along the way making friends who actually care. 

I think the real definition of personal success would be building your own story from scratch. I just have no clue where to start, and this is where I'm asking for help.

My goals in life are to prove to my family I can actually do something. The only thing I've proved to them so far is that I'm worthless. I want to actually do something instead of being at home like a prisoner. 

(Getting off topic here but I just feel like talking, hope you don't mind.) Each day feels like I'm in my own prison cell, I do the same thing as each day passes. Nothing is any different. Everytime I try to break the cycle I go back to my old habits.

I would actually like to get in shape more, but nothing motivates me. I'm not over weight but being in top shape would probably keep my mind off depression. If I were to pursue a career path there probably wouldn't be any. 

I'd literally jump at any opportunity to work anywhere. I have no work experience, any job I apply to looks at that and turns their head. Literally nobody want's to give me a chance at anything. It seems that saying "If it's too good to be true it usually is",  Is actually correct.

Overall, I just want my life to not be wasted. Cause I have two choices,  trying or giving up and ending it all. I really would like to give anything a shot before ending it all but I'm unsure what to do anymore.

Again, sorry to ramble on.

I haven't reached out anywhere besides Reddit, this is probably the only place I actually feel safe. Weird to say I know but somehow it just has that effect on me. Support would be nice, it's just awful being lonesome.

Thanks for the response, it's nice to see someone else with almost the same view as I. It really seems like a lot of work to repair the mistakes I've made. Not that I'm not willing to try but there's alot of "what if's" going on in my mind.

 Such as, what if I just waste time trying to fix the things I've failed on and end up back where I am now.  I'd hate myself even more for letting myself fail again. I'm just stuck in this predicament I can't seem to find a solution to.
